newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: REBEL SHAREHOLDER SELLS AIR STAKE.
newsitem.headline: REBEL SHAREHOLDER SELLS AIR STAKE.

text.p: Van den Hombergh Groep has sold off its entire holding in Rotterdam car dealership firm AIR Holdings, securities house Kempen & Co said on Friday.
Kempen & Co said it had sold Van den Hombergh's 150,000 ordinary shares and 115,670 convertible preference shares to several investors at prevailing market prices.
Kempen & Co said the sale was part of an agreement under which Van den Hombergh had undertaken to drop court proceedings which were aimed at extending its influence over AIR.
Van den Hombergh had gained a majority stake in AIR and had sought to oust the management and push through policy changes.

Kempen said AIR would now cancel the preference shares it had issued last year to protect itself against the takeover attempt. An attempt by Van den Hombergh to have these preference shares withdrawn through a court procedure failed in December.
AIR will now further proceed with its policy to expand in fuels trading, car rentals and real estate exploitation and will continue with further investments and acquisitions, Kempen said.
